# Legacy Payment Clause

A single-payment facade using Standard Payment Setup. `start` builds a Payment Instruction; observation follows its embedded instruction. The amount binding defaults to `/product/totalMinor` and instruction placement to `/payment`. Named payment request connections execute in the instruction by default. Explicit agreement-scoped sources add a back-reference and require an initialized host.

Only the Payment Instruction exposes guarantor acceptance and outcome operations. Creating an instruction or emitting authorization, capture, refund or void requests does not confirm money movement. Actual instruction state distinguishes acceptance, remaining secured funds, cumulative completed captures, reversals and pending requests. A void releases authorization; it is not a refund.

Configuration references: `bindings.amount` defaults to `/product/totalMinor`; `bindings.instruction` defaults to `/payment`.
